steps.text: Round fast and hit the correct nearest value — under time pressure!
Tap the option that is the correctly rounded number.
Want a fresh set of numbers? Tap “Reshuffle”.
Check the digit right after the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up, less rounds down.

coach.mission: Round fast and hit the right value.
whenStuck: Tap the correctly rounded option. “Reshuffle” gives a new set.
Check the digit after the rounding place.
whenWrong: 5 or more rounds up, less rounds down, then zero out the rest — don't rush past the deciding digit.
Re-check which place you're rounding to.
coach.done: You can round quickly now. Keep going, or move on.

steps.text: Check the digit after the rounding place: 5+ rounds up, less rounds down. Tap the correct option — fast!

onWrong: Don't rush past the deciding digit: 5+ up, less down, then zero the rest.
Double-check which place you're rounding to.
practice.done: You can round quickly and accurately, even against the clock!
